column1: # mva_synthetic=true — fabricated SnpEff ANN strings for unit tests.
# Drives tools/../tests' stub SnpEff so the adapter's subprocess plumbing, ANN
# parsing, ordering, omission and privacy behaviour can be tested hermetically,
# with no JRE and no 600 MB database. The gene symbols and transcript IDs are
# real-looking but the annotations are invented; nothing here is a patient
# coordinate and nothing here is biologically valid.
# Columns: contig<TAB>pos<TAB>ref<TAB>alt<TAB>ANN payload (as it appears after 'ANN=').
# The ERROR_CHROMOSOME_NOT_FOUND rows are copied verbatim from real SnpEff 5.4c
# output for an unknown contig: a 16-field entry with no gene and no feature.
# A site absent from this file is returned by the stub with no ANN field at all,
# which is how "the tool knows nothing" is exercised (GP-14).
